name: supervisor_two_options
description: Tests a supervisor choosing between two genuinely distinct options (search, calculate) rather than looping on a single one. judge forces its first move to search via first_iteration_step, then makes a real LLM decision among three outcomes (search, calculate, done) on later iterations. Confirms the decision-matching logic in processSupervisorDecision correctly dispatches to whichever of several options the LLM actually names. Requires GROQ_API_KEY on the worker.
